crossRefs.note: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.
These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves…

translations.web: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.
translations.bsb: For each tree is known by its own fruit. Indeed, figs are not gathered from thornbushes, nor grapes from brambles.
translations.kjv: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
translations.asv: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
